purpose: Bounded salvage of failed sad/afraid controls and generalization of the accepted happy 0.45 setting.

text_emotion_classifier.mode: isolated QwenEmotion inference before TTS generation
text_emotion_classifier.disposition: The grief description collapses almost entirely to the already failed sad axis. The fear description adds a small angry component but still depends primarily on the failed afraid axis. Live use_emo_text inference inside the resident TTS process produced no first WAV before the five-minute execution ceiling and is not a viable per-line path on this Mac.

text_derived_grief_vector.result: No WAV before the five-minute bounded worker ceiling.

sad_melancholic_blend.result: No WAV before the bounded worker exited despite one beam and max_mel_tokens 700.

afraid_surprised_blend.result: Isolated probe produced no WAV after 3.5 minutes despite one beam and max_mel_tokens 500; worker was terminated.

happy_generalization.objective_disposition: One beam is the only practical option. Three beams more than doubles unseen-line RTF for a small speaker-cosine increase. Happy remains restricted pending these three human scores.

current_direction_disposition.identity: accepted with validation and retry fallback
current_direction_disposition.melancholic: accepted at strength 0.55 and one beam
current_direction_disposition.happy: strength 0.45 pending final unseen and long-form listening
current_direction_disposition.sad: rejected; original axis weak and salvage controls generation-unstable
current_direction_disposition.afraid: rejected; original axis inaudible and salvage blend generation-unstable
